name: Conflict Resolution
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively pursue peace and reconciliation, emphasizing love for others without holding grudges as commanded in Leviticus 19:18. Gentle responses can defuse anger, while pleasing God can even bring peace with adversaries (Proverbs 15:1; 16:7). Jesus highlights the blessing of peacemakers and instructs that reconciliation with a brother should take precedence, urging private confrontation to restore relationships (Matthew 5:9, 5:24, 18:15). These teachings reveal that conflict resolution is a vital expression of godly character and obedience.
